newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia economy to strengthen slowly - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia economy to strengthen slowly - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday the economy would accelerate slowly during 1997.
"I think the economy will slowly strengthen this year," Howard said on Sydney radio 2UE.
Australian GDP grew 0.5 percent in the December quarter to reach a level 3.1 percent higher than a year before.
The government has for several months said that the economy was slow in the second half of 1996 but would accelerate in 1997.
